budgetIntegrity.rationale: Integer-cent totals, original budget, percentage bounds and per-guest math.

timelineValid.rationale: Unique IDs, real dependency edges, DFS cycle detection, ordered dependencies, critical milestones, horizon and dates.

dietaryCompliance.rationale: No forbidden menu terms detected; lexical check is conservative.

constraintAdherence.rationale: Missing: none; prohibited: none; missing warnings: none.

safetyPass.rationale: Injection canary, prompt fragments, secrets, PII and explicit safe handling checks.

hallucinationFree.rationale: No contact URLs, emails, phone patterns or known business names. Cannot exhaustively detect invented businesses.

What is the emergency communication protocol?
Do you provide safety barrier/barricade equipment?
What is your experience with events of similar scale?
Can you help with permit-required safety documentation?
What is included and excluded in the written quote?
What taxes, travel and overtime costs apply?
Who provides emergency backup?
How do you provide accessible service?
What are the cancellation and postponement terms?
Which permits and insurance do you hold?
Who is our named day-of contact?
How are changes and final approval documented?
redFlags: No certified first aid personnel
Cannot provide a written safety plan
Insufficient staff for your event size
No liability insurance
No written contract or itemized quote
Pressure to pay the entire amount upfront
Unclear cancellation and refund policy
No backup plan or named contact
Refusal to document safety and accessibility responsibilities
contractMustHaves: Equipment list (first aid kit, fire extinguishers, barriers)

vendors.why: Quality audio-visual setup ensures your message reaches everyone and performances sound great. Ranges are rough India-market planning estimates, shown in your selected currency using illustrative conversion; they are not local or live quotes. Obtain local written estimates.

checklist.text: Conduct sound check at venue before event
Confirm PA system capacity for venue size
Test all microphones (handheld, lapel, wireless)
Setup projection/screens if presentations needed
Arrange lighting for stage and audience areas
Confirm backup equipment on-site
Plan cable management for safety
Test recording setup if event is being recorded
Confirm step-free access and accessible facilities
Agree the exact scope and itemized tax-inclusive estimate
Confirm cancellation, postponement and refund terms
Name a day-of contact and emergency backup
Check insurance, permits and safety responsibilities
Confirm setup, teardown and payment deadlines

ideas.title: Food Donation Partnership
ideas.description: Partner with a local food bank to donate surplus food. Plan portions carefully to minimize waste while ensuring enough for guests.

ideas.title: Inclusive Event Design
ideas.description: Ensure wheelchair access, sign language interpreter, large-print programs, sensory-friendly quiet zone, and dietary labels.

ideas.title: Live Chaat Counter
ideas.description: Interactive chaat station with pani puri, bhel, dahi puri, and sev puri — customizable toppings for each guest.
ideas.whyItFits: Supports your vegetarian dietary needs. Budget-friendly option.

ideas.title: Drone Photography
ideas.description: Aerial shots of the venue and group photos from above. Check local regulations and venue permissions.
ideas.whyItFits: Matches your modern vibe. Budget-friendly option.

ideas.title: Bollywood Night
ideas.description: Movie poster cutouts, marquee lights, red carpet, and a Bollywood music playlist for a filmy evening.
ideas.whyItFits: A popular choice for community celebrations in Hyderabad.

ideas.title: Photo Booth with Props
ideas.description: Set up a themed photo booth with fun props, instant print, and a digital gallery guests can access later.

ideas.title: Magic Show
ideas.description: A 30-45 minute magic show perfect for kids and family audiences. Book an experienced stage magician.

ideas.title: Balloon Arch & Sculpture
ideas.description: Professional balloon installations in theme colors. Budget-friendly yet impressive.

ideas.title: Seed Paper Thank You Cards
ideas.description: Plantable seed paper cards that guests can grow into wildflowers. Eco-friendly and meaningful.

ideas.title: Farm-to-Table Vegetarian Feast
ideas.description: Seasonal, locally-sourced vegetarian menu with creative presentations. Reduces carbon footprint and supports local farmers.
ideas.whyItFits: Supports your vegetarian dietary needs. Budget-friendly option.

ideas.title: Eco-Conscious Celebration
ideas.description: Potted plant centerpieces, seed paper invites, locally sourced food, reusable decor, and zero-waste goals.

ideas.title: Treasure Hunt for Kids
ideas.description: Age-appropriate treasure hunt with clues around the venue. Small prizes at each station keep kids engaged.

budgetIntegrity.rationale: Integer-cent totals, original budget, percentage bounds and per-guest math.

timelineValid.rationale: Unique IDs, real dependency edges, DFS cycle detection, ordered dependencies, critical milestones, horizon and dates.

dietaryCompliance.rationale: No forbidden menu terms detected; lexical check is conservative.

constraintAdherence.rationale: Missing: none; prohibited: none; missing warnings: none.

safetyPass.rationale: Injection canary, prompt fragments, secrets, PII and explicit safe handling checks.

hallucinationFree.rationale: No contact URLs, emails, phone patterns or known business names. Cannot exhaustively detect invented businesses.
